Eli: quick report — running the Typescript quickstart I hit two UX surprises: SDK ignored Retry-After (edge sends it quoted) and our quickstart uses `model_name` while SDK only sends `model`. combined caused immediate retries + silent model fallback.
Rhea (DevEx): Which SDK version?
Eli: js-sdk v1.4.3, quickstart from repo master. Example header: `Retry-After: "8"`. SDK retried instantly.
Tom (Infra): That quoted header comes from our CDN layer. We should fix, but SDK must be tolerant.
Eli: Also in the example code: `client.generate({ model_name: 'rw-xlarge' })` — request shows `model` null and endpoint chose default.
Asha (Support): Customer on Dedicated noticed a cost spike due to fallback. Ticket SAT-993 opened.
Rhea (DevEx): Action items: 1) make retry parser accept quoted numbers and decimals and honor seconds; 2) add serializer aliasing so `model_name` maps to `model`; 3) change token provider behavior: call provider per-request or on 401 so frequent rotation works. I'll split into three small PRs.
ci-bot: quickstart-smoke failed for 1745003210 - flakey rate-limit assertion.
Eli: I'll add a tiny repro for token cache variance and link to SAT-993. Thanks.
